ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-14-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Dave Davenport.
Petitioner: Max Ray Butler, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Max Ray Vision.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-31-2007 Reset To Aug-14-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: F. Butler.
Petitioner: Max Ray Butler, present in pro per.
Unable to provide the Court with an original Proof of Publication, matter in continued to Aug. 14, 2007 at 9:00 A.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to obtain an original Proof of Publication with the correct case number and bring it to the court on the next hearing date.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
